## Method:

**6) Steffen Method** Supposed to be the most optimal method

## Planning:

**6) Steffen Method** The 72 passengers are lined up and seated in the following order, from back to front: 1) Window seat, odd-numbered 2) Window seat, even-numbered 3) Middle seat, odd-numbered 4) Middle seat, even-numbered 5) Aisle seat, odd-numbered 6) Aisle seat, even-numbered It is supposed to be the most optimal boarding method.
